```{r}
#| include: false
# Shared setup, included at the top of every chapter.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = "#>", fig.align = "center", dpi = 150)

# Point R at the Python used for the {python} cells. RETICULATE_PYTHON, written
# into .Renviron by scripts/setup_local.R, takes precedence; the fallbacks are
# for a machine where that has not been run.
if (requireNamespace("reticulate", quietly = TRUE) &&
    Sys.getenv("RETICULATE_PYTHON") == "") {
  env <- Sys.getenv("HDS_PYTHON_ENV", "hds-python")
  if (reticulate::virtualenv_exists(env)) {
    reticulate::use_virtualenv(env, required = TRUE)
  } else {
    try(reticulate::use_condaenv(env, required = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
  }
}
```
